sections.title: Profile
sections.text: AI & Software Engineer with 8+ years in Finland, experienced in building production-ready AI systems that integrate machine learning, LLMs and Generative AI into real-world applications. Proven ability to design scalable AI pipelines, connect AI models to external data sources (aligned with Model Context Protocol principles) and deploy cloud-native solutions on AWS and Azure. Strong software engineering foundation combined with hands-on experience in MLOps, responsible AI practices and cross-functional delivery.

items.title: LEAD SOFTWARE & AI ENGINEER (project research and development)
items.subtitle: University of Turku, Turku
bullets: Led the development of a novel automated AI-powered machine vision system for food detection and nutritional analysis. Published in GCAIOT 2025 conference. Link https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11275545
Designed and deployed **end-to-end AI pipelines**, integrating models (Deep learning, CNN, LLMs) using **openCV, PyTorch, pathlib, TensorFlow** etc.
Built scalable backend services using **FastAPI and WebSockets** for real-time data processing, analysis and correction for multiple modular pipelines.
Developed full-stack system **(React + PostgreSQL)** supporting **Admins, Researchers, and End Users** with integrated **scale, camera and menu data**.
Automated **data collection, re-correction, and analysis**, improving efficiency.
Direct AI based result was recorrected using scaled weight and menu based correction so the error was reduced and **accuracy was over 80%**.
Applied **Scikit-learn, Pandas, Numpy** etc. for data preprocessing, evaluation and model optimization.
Accepted overall **3 papers** from the project (**Lead Author of 2 papers**)
